# Glintbase Agent Harness (ARS 3.0)

> Autonomous agent-readiness auditor, Agent Flight Simulator, living artifact generator & CI quality gate.

## Documentation

- [Core Commands Handbook](https://github.com/athertech/glintbase-cli#core-commands): Comprehensive usage guides for audit, simulate, fix, and ci commands
- [Autonomous Agent Flight Simulator](https://github.com/athertech/glintbase-cli#2-glintbase-simulate-target): Empirical agent trajectory execution for Claude Code, Cursor, and Perplexity
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP) Guide](https://github.com/athertech/glintbase-cli#specifications--standards-supported): Streamable HTTP MCP server route, JSON-RPC 2.0, and tool schemas
- [CI/CD Drift Shield](https://github.com/athertech/glintbase-cli#github-action-integration): GitHub Actions workflow configuration and quality gate rules
- [Machine Authentication Handbook](/auth.md): Bearer token, client credentials, and error recovery guide

## Optional

- [Full Documentation](/llms-full.txt): Complete concatenated documentation for agent ingestion
- [Agent Resource Discovery](/.well-known/ard.json): Standard ARD v0.91 catalog manifest
